test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the word that is different from the other three.
solution:
Lets check each option and identify which one is different:

1) Hand → Hand is an external organ of the body.

2) Kidney → It is an internal organ of the body.

3) Heart → It is an internal organ of the body.

4) Liver → It is an internal organ of the body.

Clearly,** Hand is the odd one out** because it is the only external organ while others are internal organs of the body.

Hence,** 'option 1' **is the correct answer.
